why: KeirDillon.com has not published /about or /tools yet, and Dillon Agency launches first. Until the personal site is live, these three links point at the personal homepage and carry a label that honestly describes where the visitor lands. src/pages.py already holds the final href and label for each one.
restore: Set "active" to false, rebuild, redeploy. Nothing else needs editing — src/pages.py already holds the final href and label for each link. build.py fails the build if any entry below stops matching, so a stale bridge cannot pass silently.

links.final_label: Read the full story on Keir’s site
links.temporary_label: More on Keir’s background at KeirDillon.com

note_on_verify: After restoring, `verify.py --peer-project` will flag /about and /tools. That is expected, not a fault: the peer's page-inventory.json records build paths with a trailing slash (/about/), while the peer serves and canonicalises them without one (trailingSlash:false). Linking to the slash-free form is correct and saves a redirect hop.
